owner: HSWM native context interpreter; canonical atom owners retain their authority
scope: Local source-bound engineering bundle and caller-scoped context observation; no live KG publication or canonical admission

competency_questions.question: Which implementation enforces candidate binding, complete roles, abstention, bounds and outcome attribution?
Which owned executable and help page operate this context selector?
What did the scripted advisory receipt select, at which context size?
Which exact participant versions fill each ordered role, including mandatory context and exceptions?

identity.plan: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(bound plan); versioned spec, canonical revision and exact candidate/root/participant bindings
identity.selection: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(selection); includes exact request and supplied receipt hashes
identity.candidate: SHA-256 of plan hash plus candidate ID
identity.assembly: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(assembly before adding its own digest)
identity.frame: Assembly hash plus frame ordinal; retains original frame digest and relation key
identity.role_occurrence: Frame UID plus original role ordinal; same participant in different slots never collapses
identity.participant: Exact canonical schema, lineage, atom UID and revision key
identity.engineering: Root sym:AbstractNode:hswm-jev-context-2026-10-09-root; stable sym:Concept:hswm-jev-context-2026-10-09-{id} members; source paths are attributes, not identity

relations.direction: implementation or open measurement to original rule
relations.meaning: Implementation correspondence, no claim of full rule optimization or changed user canon

relations.range: Existing Jev research bundle UID anchor

validation.rdf_profile: Existing native kg-bundle-rdf/v2 with reified edges and PROV-O derivation
validation.runtime: Schema decoding and exact native read validate semantic exception references; SHACL validates projected structure, not natural-language truth
validation.time: File date is engineering record time; model inference time is unobserved in scripted fixtures
validation.graph_cycles: No global DAG assumption; frame/slot ownership cardinality only

projection_loss: View is selection and assembly, not the complete canonical state or journal.
Supersedes edges are not role slots; exact relation revision is retained.
Candidate summaries are caller-authored MAPs; their sufficiency is unknown.
Execution trace and attributed outcome are separate content-store records linked by hashes, not RDF nodes in this version.
Context-byte budget excludes HTTP envelope, model tokens, memory and end-to-end latency.
No model calibration, Semantic Weight update, causal credit, formal proof or superintelligence result follows from this projection.
rollback: Remove new context adapter, workspace entry and navigation links; preserve canonical graph, staged evidence, older sources and other writers.
